sources.label: Wikipedia, "HIP 67522 b"
sources.quote: HIP 67522 b is a hot Neptune or sub-Saturn exoplanet orbiting the G-type star HIP 67522, approximately 415 light-years from Earth in the constellation Centaurus.

introduction.text: It is one of 2 planets known around HIP 67522. Its orbit and size follow Barber et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
